claim_policy: Requests in GitHub issues are pending until the coordinator publishes one owner here; a fork or local copy cannot grant ownership.

tasks.title: Prove cached FSM timeout/tick contract
tasks.scope: Next technical task reserved to the coordinator; no new timeout execution is claimed by this onboarding session.
acceptance: Execute the real getter and verified critical helpers.
Test threshold boundaries and 32-bit tick wrap before assigning units or interpreting Beta3's 30-to-40 change.

tasks.title: Classify the nine changed V3.6/V3.8 data cells
tasks.scope: Trace consumers of the changed block; keep code identity and changed data separate.
acceptance: Reproduce the existing raw delta, then add new consumer evidence rather than another diff report.
Resolve each claimed reference and distinguish proof from a candidate.
Do not reclassify the block as PWM prescalers: the verified pointer reaches the next, unchanged table.

tasks.title: Bound the full-queue, nonzero-wait send path
tasks.scope: Start with full queue, positive wait and no waiting consumers; identify the first tick/scheduler boundary. Do not attempt a whole RTOS.
acceptance: Preserve the established available-send/full-zero-wait contract.
Record every remaining scheduler/tick model and exact stop boundary.
Do not edit or analyze the reserved FSM timeout branch.

tasks.title: Bound the modeled record-text leaf
tasks.scope: Verify entry/bounds and the record-text helper currently modeled by the refresh runner; focus on bounded reads/writes.
acceptance: Provide guarded original-byte scope, input/output and write-boundary evidence.
Keep remaining widget/log calls explicit; do not claim complete GUI correctness.
Do not redo the completed renderer state matrix.

tasks.title: Build one reference-backed UART identification lead
inputs: public pinned references; original images for target validation
tasks.scope: Select one pinned UART routine/register sequence and resolve candidate target references. Keep SoC UART separate from any unproven external measurement-ADC identity.
acceptance: Cite the pinned upstream source and its license.
Resolve literals/relocations and report negative matches as well as any candidate.
Do not authorize a Ghidra rename from similarity alone; no physical device access.

tasks.title: Audit conservative literal tracking with new negative controls
inputs: public source and synthetic ARM fixtures; no firmware required
tasks.scope: Examine shifted/register-offset/writeback/conditional cases not already covered by the nine provenance tests. Change code only after a concrete independently specified failing case.
acceptance: ADD/SUB immediate and MOV propagation already exist; do not implement a purported missing ADD-zero feature.
Supply new positive/negative fixtures and the reason each expected result is sound.
Place a proposed patch in the task directory; do not edit shared tooling until integrated.

tasks.title: Audit evidence and address consistency
inputs: public documents and evidence; no firmware required
tasks.scope: Cross-check recent function entries, image hashes, proof scope and prose against the machine database and committed evidence.
acceptance: Report exact artifact/JSON field or line references and proposed corrections.
Account for corrected entries 0x800037c0/0x8005d048 and base 0x7fffffe0.
Do not rerun completed disassembly or add an invented completion percentage.

tasks.title: Passive UART capture and board connection validation
inputs: owner-assisted physical access and verified electrical/pin mapping
tasks.scope: Future hardware validation only. No capture, connection or current USB/FEL availability is claimed by this session.
acceptance: Obtain verified pin/voltage information and owner-assisted access before any connection.
Keep observed capture distinct from FEL/static/emulated state.
